summary: Tested Inventory page column sorting (new feature) added to Product ID, Description, Category, On-Hand Qty, UOM, Unit Cost, Total Value headers. Verified ascending/descending toggle, caret indicators, sort persisting through pagination, sort combined with search+category filter, and row-expand/collapse interaction post-sort. Also did regression pass on Admin and BOM Explorer existing sort - both still working. Purchasing Plan regression check inconclusive due to slow plan generation (pre-existing tenant flakiness, unrelated to this change).
action_items: No action required for the sorting feature - all tested scenarios passed.

Purchasing Plan sort regression could not be fully verified this run because 'Generate Purchasing Plan' took >68s without completing (pre-existing SAP tenant flakiness noted by main agent, not caused by this change). Recommend a follow-up quick check on Purchasing Plan sort headers next time tenant is responsive - not blocking since Purchasing Plan was NOT modified by this change.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryPage.js sort implementation (handleSort, sorted useMemo) mirrors existing pattern (numericSortFields array, asc/desc toggle) - clean and consistent with Admin/BOM Explorer/Purchasing Plan pages.
Sort correctly runs after 'filtered' useMemo and before pagination slice, so filter+sort+pagination interplay is correct (verified via test).
null/missing numeric values handled by defaulting to -Infinity so they sort to the bottom in ascending order - reasonable UX choice, confirmed no crash on items with '—' values.
test_credentials: No app auth required; not needed for this test.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing live inventory dataset (3176 items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inventory sorting feature fully verified: all 7 columns sortable asc/desc with caret indicators; sort+filter(category)+search combos correctly maintain sort order; sort order maintained correctly across pagination (page1 last value >= page2 first value in desc mode); row expand/collapse for location breakdown works fine after sorting/filtering. Admin page sort regression confirmed working (admin-sort-* testids). BOM Explorer sort regression confirmed working (bom-sort-header-* testids) after pulling a BOM (P26584). Purchasing Plan sort regression NOT fully verified - plan generation was still running after 68+ seconds during this test session (matches the known intermittent SAP tenant slowness mentioned in review context); if retesting, allow several minutes for 'Generate Purchasing Plan' to complete before checking sort headers there.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the sorting feature itself. Purchasing Plan generation delay is attributed to pre-existing SAP tenant/backend flakiness described by main agent, unrelated to the Inventory sorting change under test.
